title: Axial refill force and paper-normal force measured apart; friction vector map; static side load
measures: F_c (in-line cell) and N, f (plate under the paper) at theta 35/50/75 deg (+65), 8 stroke directions, 1-100 mm/s, F_c 0.05-0.5 N; indentation
decision: The static balance range the nib must carry per newton of F_c (study B); friction parameters of sim2; whether P-6/P-7 hold
merges: EXP-B01 Parts 1-2 (re-specified: plate in the page frame + in-line axial cell instead of one F/T on the holder); EXP-V01; EXP-Q01 and EXP-D01 as head variants

title: Minimum reliable ink force and ink continuity
measures: Gap fraction along force-ramp and fixed-force lines; >= 3 refill types (4 proposed) x 6 papers x 35/50/75 deg x 10/30/100 mm/s x 5 repeats; line width and density
decision: F_c,min per refill and paper; the refill choice; the bottom of the static balance range
merges: EXP-B01 Part 4; EXP-Q02 Part A; EXP-B08 (modulated force, optional part)

rig: R9 + R13 stage on the head
title: Friction dynamics at tremor amplitudes (pre-sliding, reversals)
measures: Reciprocation 0.02-0.5 mm at 3-15 Hz with and without drift; velocity steps at quarter-decade speeds; slow triangular sweeps 5 um-1 mm
decision: LuGre or multi-state friction in sim2 (DEC-011, DEC-040)
merges: EXP-B01 Part 3; EXP-B02 (analysis by s2r.exp_b01b02.identify on s2r-bench-1 records)

title: Page-relative sensing qualification: accuracy, noise, scale, working band, dropout
measures: Sensor vs encoder (or camera) truth: DeltaPen 10 ms-window errors (magnitude and vector), per-sample noise, stroke error after calibration, scale and rotation vs tilt/height/roll, dropouts; six papers + glossy, printed and fresh ink; tremor overlay
decision: Whether ordinary-paper sensing is good enough to replace external truth; which die and optics; which papers are supported
requirements: REQ-SNS-001; REQ-SNS-002; REQ-RVJ-N06; REQ-RVJ-I07; REQ-DRV-005; REQ-RVJ-C05
merges: EXP-S01 (accuracy and noise parts); EXP-B04 procedure 5; EXP-N07; EXP-J04; EXP-J10 including its addition: every 10 ms window error and its correlation over time, exported as sim2j's page-noise model (rig.pagesense.sim2j_page_model)

title: Page-sensor latency (step and phase methods)
measures: Latency from a voice-coil step (encoder 50 % crossing to sensor 50 % crossing, >= 200 steps) and from the phase slope under multitone motion
decision: Prediction horizon of the estimator; whether the 5 ms delay budget (REQ-CTRL-003) holds
merges: EXP-S01 procedures 1-3 (strobe method kept as an option)

title: Recording pen and tablet protocol: qualification and real-writing force split
measures: Tablet protocol (ink on paper on an EMR tablet): sampling rate and jitter, position vs scanned ink; recording pen: axial force, IMU; paper-normal force on the R9 plate; the excess-power method on injected amplitudes
decision: Whether EXP-H01 can start on the tablet protocol before the recording pen exists; real axial-vs-normal force distributions for the balance range
merges: EXP-H01 instrumentation (AC-H01-08); EXP-V03 inputs; EXP-V07 (12 healthy adults on a >= 200 Hz tablet) runs on this protocol

title: Actuator coupon: 2-D force/current/displacement map and K_m(position)
measures: Force vector against current (+-I reversals) on a grid over the full magnet stroke (translation or tilt about the pivot), both axes and both together; back-EMF K_f; R20, L
decision: Voice-coil geometry; reject force models that miss by > 10 %; the firmware force map
merges: EXP-B03 items 2-5; EXP-N01; EXP-J14 (K_m part); EXP-K01 (force constant part)

title: Parasitic attraction, negative stiffness and loaded modes at temperature
measures: Axial pull against gap and offset; zero-current lateral force map (negative stiffness); current-to-position FRF of the magnet-loaded suspension at 23, 35 and 50 C; K_f(T), R(T)
decision: Flexure feasibility under the pull (buckling margin, stiffness balance); thermal derating of K_f
merges: EXP-J01; EXP-J11 step 1 (stiffness vs preload); EXP-J14 (pull); EXP-B03 item 6 (thermal steps)

title: Hall-sensor interference in the real magnetic neighbourhood
measures: Hall output at fixed positions against coil current (DC with the linear amplifier, PWM with the pen's driver), magnet position and temperature
decision: Sensor placement and compensation; whether the position sensor meets its error budget

title: One-axis loaded nib: disturbance rejection and bandwidth in contact
measures: Swept-sine and Schroeder multitone housing disturbance 1-30 Hz, 0.25-2 mm peak (acceleration-capped), in contact at 35/50/75 deg on 3 paper stacks; housing truth (LM13), ink truth (camera + scan), nib current
decision: A useful correction bandwidth under contact (review G3)
merges: EXP-I05 items 3-4; EXP-N03 (closed loop); EXP-B05 procedure 3 in contact; EXP-B09 one-axis precursor; EXP-Q06

title: Large excursions, bounded current and stable pen lift
measures: Amplitude ladder to saturation; peak current against the limit; recovery; 1.5 mm lifts at 50/60/70 deg and touchdowns; ink tails
decision: Graceful limits and the lift design
merges: EXP-N05 step 4; EXP-Q08; EXP-F01 (over-current in contact)

rig: Part A: R9 frame, nib module on the head, ball on the force plate; part B: R13
title: Static side load and holding power over tilt, roll and stroke direction
measures: Part A (= EXP-J17): the nose or nib module held on R9's head, ball on the K3D40 plate at 35/50/75 deg, 60 s each, refill spring 0.15 N: coil current (shunt channel), coil temperature (thermocouple and 4-wire resistance) and, at the same time, the plate's side load and friction (load-path check); first the C1S nose, then the balanced nib. Part B on R13: roll +-20 deg, 8 directions, F_c 0.08-0.2 N, balance mechanism on and off
decision: Whether the balanced nib removes the review's section-4 holding load (study B's design question); whether the C1S load path matches its model (DEC-046)
merges: EXP-J17 (part A, unchanged pass line); otherwise new: the static term was missing from every earlier protocol

title: Two-axis nib: sharp turns, repeated contacts, full roll and tilt
measures: Feature course (corners, dots, hatching, fast strokes) under multitone tremor; 500 touchdowns; tilt 35-75 deg, roll +-20 deg; scanned ink
decision: Whether the core stays useful outside a short ideal trace (review G4)
merges: EXP-B09 (two-axis); EXP-N02; EXP-N08 (later); part of EXP-V05

title: Two-axis nib with its own page sensor: optical dropout while writing
measures: Forced dropouts (glossy strip, ink crossing, 2 mm lift, occlusion) during tremor writing; authority fade and re-acquisition; ink excursions
decision: Fault handling of the page sensor in closed loop
merges: EXP-N07 (in the pen); EXP-F02 (sensor faults, part)

title: Long thermal run with the governor
measures: 30-60 min of design duty and a worst-case duty (35 deg, 2 mm tremor) in a 30 C room; coil by resistance, magnets and web by thermocouple, IR map; governor state
decision: Heat and runtime of the balanced nib; the governor's limits
merges: EXP-N04; EXP-J05; EXP-J13; EXP-B07 (pen); EXP-P01 (nib-power part)

title: Collar and tail on a grip simulant: none, same mass locked, unpowered, active
measures: Same tasks and disturbance seeds in four conditions at three grip strengths; ink error; instrument translation and rotation; module power
decision: Incremental active benefit per added gram, watt and grip effort (review G5)

title: Grip simulant qualification against measured grasp impedance
measures: Simulant FRF in translation and rotation, 1-20 Hz, at each squeeze setting, against HAP-26 until EXP-B06/I01/V04 measure people
decision: Whether R14 results can be read as grip-dependent at all
